headline: Leafs’ Morgan Rielly leaves game with lower-body injury
take:
Morgan Rielly left Saturday's loss to Montreal with a lower-body injury after only 5:45 of ice time, Daily Faceoff reports. There's no word yet on how long he'll be out.

The timing is rough for Toronto. The Leafs are 8-8-2, they've taken 47.19% of the expected goals this season (expected goals measure the quality of chances), and their 64 goals are 8.5 more than those chances usually produce. A team leaning on finishing can't afford to lose the players who tilt the ice, and Rielly does: Toronto's five-on-five expected-goals share is 2.23 points better with him on than off. His own line is quiet, 12 assists and no goals in 18 games, on 1.45 expected goals, so the goals should come if he's healthy. The Leafs play again tonight against a Devils team that has won four straight.
